name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.5.0 (released 2026-07-04) is the largest release since v0.4.0, spanning 238 commits. Key additions include Connect Knowledge (read-only Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive/SharePoint, Dropbox integration per room), a 52-connector Integrations Hub (Slack, Google, Microsoft 365, Snowflake, LinkedIn, Discord, Telegram), and per-room agent Channels with live @mention replies. The release also introduces a Telegram remote-control gateway, clean-path routing replacing hash-based URLs, PBKDF2 password hashing with rate-limiting, and a significantly enhanced editor with Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX support. See the release notes at https://github.com/hilash/cabinet.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — v0.5.0 released 2026-07-04 with 238 commits and active contributor activity
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Yes — PBKDF2 password hashing with per-install salt, login rate-limiting, mobile browser support, and reverse proxy compatibility

breaking_excerpts: Clean-path routing: the app now serves clean URLs instead of hash routes across web and Electron; old hash links resolve via a marker-scan parser but the canonical form is path-based.
Channels on-disk rename: the internal team-chat directory moved from '.slack' to '.channels', scoped per room.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more powerful document management with OCR, tagging, and full-text search, but is significantly heavier and more complex to self-host than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy provides a more feature-rich document management system with workflows and metadata support, but requires more resources and setup compared to Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell excels at automated document processing and tagging with AI assistance, but has a steeper learning curve and heavier infrastructure than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash is similarly lightweight and focused on file browsing with support for many storage backends, but lacks dedicated document management features like tagging or OCR.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud
alternatives.review: Nextcloud offers a comprehensive file and document management platform with a large ecosystem of apps, but is far heavier and more complex than the minimalist Cabinet approach.
